system.description:
Like a spider, you've cast a net of communications throughout a city, region, or even countryside, courier-ing messages through known Nosferatu means — pigeons, caravans, Gangrel scouts, or homing beasts trained via Discipline — without knowing for certain they'll be reliably transmitted to other Nosferatu in your area of influence. These communications are not entirely secure, however: your messages travel on the lips of those who aid a variety of Nosferatu, so another who has earned their trust could well catch wind of what you are conveying. This Background is distinct from Information Network, which represents ambient local rumor rather than a directed messenger network, and from Contacts, which represents a specific individual source of aid.

System: Dots in this Background represent how trusted and connected the character is in the local network of couriers, and thus how far and wide a message is reliably conveyed (one dot: a single city; two: two cities; three: three cities or a country's district; four: four major cities or a geographic region; five: an entire country). This also determines how easily the vampire can tap into others' messages: the Storyteller can allow the player to roll Charisma + Subterfuge (difficulty 10 minus dots in Couriers) to learn whether anything interesting is passing through the local network. A player wanting a more secure, personally loyal messenger should consider the Retainers Background instead.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Two: Lepers
